description: This PHP source file defines the ImageController class responsible for handling image requests related to corporate branding themes within the OrangeHRM system. It processes requests for images such as client logo, banner, and login banner, managing caching headers and content responses.

classes.name: ImageController
classes.description: Controller class handling image retrieval and caching for corporate branding themes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request to serve a specific theme-related image, managing ETag caching and content delivery.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers for the image response, including content type and cache control directives.
